ssl.label: origin of the August expansion leg (10-Aug)

narrative: MCX ran 2603.20 -> 3023.70 between 10-Aug and 13-Aug, a 16% expansion. Since that high it has printed three consecutive lower highs (3023.70 -> 2977.40 -> 2951.00) and three lower lows (2929.00 -> 2911.50 -> 2892.10), so the last three sessions are a clean short-term downtrend inside a much larger uptrend. This morning price swept 2892.10, below Friday's 2911.50 low, and reclaimed hard to 2945 within the hour, leaving a 15M bullish imbalance at 2929.00-2932.00 and an order block at 2912.00-2929.00. That is a textbook sell-side raid and reclaim - but the reclaim is one hour old on an incomplete daily bar, the swept low is not yet a confirmed daily swing, and NIFTY is in its own daily downtrend (lower highs since 10-Aug, 24282 now). Directional bias is therefore genuinely two-sided and the draw is unresolved.
invalidation: The long thesis requires price to hold above 2892.10 and pull back into 2904.47-2914.48 rather than running away from it. A 15M close back below 2892.10 voids the reclaim entirely and turns the morning move into a failed bounce inside the three-day downtrend. Equally, an impulsive move straight to 2977 without a retracement means the entry never triggers - stand down rather than chase.
